newsitem.title: USA: Tel-Save in AOL long-distance deal.
newsitem.headline: Tel-Save in AOL long-distance deal.

text.p: Tel-Save Holdings Inc said on Tuesday it reached an exclusive multiyear agreement with America Online Inc to offer long-distance telephone service to AOL customers.
Tel-Save made an initial $100 million payment to AOL as part of the deal, and will provide further payments based on a percentage of Tel-Save's profits.

The service, which Tel-Save said will offer AOL members "one of the lowest long-distance rates in the industry," begins with a sampling of the on-line service's members in early summer, and is to be offered to all of them in the fall.

The deal provides Tel-Save with exclusive rights regarding local and wireless services, which would be offered as a package when available. Tel-Save said it would offer the industry's first online sign-up and billing set-up, with AOL customers enrolling through on-line screens and being billed through their credit cards.
Tel-Save said AOL made a "significant" commitment to promote the new service to its members.
